name: Positron Energy Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Positron Energy Ltd provides gas distribution solutions and management & technical advisory services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PEL, an ISO 9001:2015 & ISO 45001:2018 certified company, specializes in management and technical advisory services for the oil and gas industry. It provides end-to-end gas distribution solutions, including commercial and financial advisory, project management, and O&M services.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 46.0%
Debtor days have improved from 48.2 to 34.8 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.6.55 Cr.
